article.title: Concession etc., to be deemed to have been granted to Producer Company.
article.content: With effect from the date of transformation, all fiscal and other concessions, licences, benefits, privileges and exemptions granted to the inter-State co-operative society in connection with the affairs and business of the inter-State co-operative society under any law for the time being in force shall be deemed to have been granted to the Producer Company.
article.html:
378MConcession etc., to be deemed to have been granted to Producer Company.

Section 378M · Chapter XXIA · Part II · page 208 of the Act

With effect from the date of transformation, all fiscal and other concessions, licences, benefits, privileges and exemptions granted to the inter-State co-operative society in connection with the affairs and business of the inter-State co-operative society under any law for the time being in force shall be deemed to have been granted to the Producer Company.
